auth._comment: When proxyUrl is set, the hub uses worker-mediated email/password sign-in. Set it to null to fall back to direct PAT mode.

_live: Live push over a websocket, on since 2026-09-10. Pages connect to the worker's /live and refresh when told, with the poll still running underneath at a slower interval so a socket that dies quietly makes the page slower rather than wrong. Set this to false to put every page back on polling alone; the worker's RACE_HUB binding is the other switch and either one off is enough.
